_comment: Machine-readable mirror of the 'Measured performance characteristics' table
in docs/operator/cost-model.md. The weekly competitor-benchmark CI job
(.github/workflows/benchmarks.yml) runs the Criterion suites and compares the
metrics below against these baselines via scripts/compare_benchmarks.py,
failing if any regresses by more than `tolerance_pct`. Keep the numbers here
in sync with the prose table when a baseline is intentionally re-measured.
